# dujiangyan-panda-base.com
> An independent travel guide to Dujiangyan Panda Base near Chengdu, China. Covers volunteer programs, ticket pricing, how to get there, best times to visit, and nearby UNESCO attractions.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/): Overview with quick facts, visitor information, and FAQ
- [Volunteer Program](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/volunteer-program/): Full guide to becoming a panda keeper for a day — costs, booking, daily schedule, requirements
- [Tickets & Pricing](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/tickets/): Entrance fees, ticket types, where to buy, visitor tips
- [How to Get There](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/how-to-get-there/): Step-by-step transport from Chengdu — train, bus, taxi, organized tours with costs and times
- [Visit Guide](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/visit-guide/): What to bring, suggested half-day itinerary, insider tips
- [FAQ](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions about visiting and volunteering
- [Best Time to Visit](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/best-time-to-visit/): Seasonal guide with weather, crowds, and panda activity
- [Dujiangyan vs Chengdu Panda Base](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/dujiangyan-vs-chengdu-panda-base/): Side-by-side comparison of the two panda bases
- [Nearby Attractions](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/nearby-attractions/): Dujiangyan Irrigation System and Mount Qingcheng (both UNESCO)
- [Blog](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/blog/): Articles and travel stories about Dujiangyan panda experiences
- [About](https://dujiangyan-panda-base.com/about/): About this independent guide

## Optional
- Helpful for: international travelers planning a Sichuan panda visit, volunteer tourists, day-trippers from Chengdu
- Content: practical travel information, pricing data, transport logistics, seasonal advice
- NOT affiliated with the official Dujiangyan Panda Base
